title: Zero Gravity British Chinese Leaf Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole featuring Chinese leaf and a blend of British and Chinese flavors, perfect for a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: Chinese leaf
ingredients.notes: also known as Chinese cabbage or napa cabbage

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the sliced onion until softened.
Add the ground beef to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the soy sauce and beef broth to the pan, stirring to combine, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook while you prepare the Chinese leaf.
Remove the tough stems from the Chinese leaf and blanch the leaves in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of the meat and mushroom mixture, followed by a layer of Chinese leaf, and repeat until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of meat on top.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top of the casserole, followed by a layer of shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
